Automated translation (refer to source for accuracy)

The Children's Library will close temporarily for facility repairs during the following period.

We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your understanding and cooperation.

【Closure Period (all day)】

December 4, 2025 (Friday) through January 15, 2026 (Friday)

【Changes During Closure】

• Library browsing, book checkout, and returns at the Children's Library will not be available.

• If you have materials on hold at the Children's Library, please pick them up at the Main Library instead.

• The book drop box will remain available during the closure period.

Source (Japanese): https://www.hanno-lib.jp/calendar/post-85.html
